what_happened.line: The Select Board spent most of the meeting on the town manager's composite annual performance evaluation, accepted without objection as read with one word changed in section 4.
The board heard that the trash and recycling contract is moving from Casella to a new vendor on June 30th, and that bag prices are expected to rise.
The town manager reported on a library recarpeting bid and on electricity aggregation, whose three-year contract expires in November and has gone out to bid.
The board was asked to have the town manager contact the operators of the clothing bins at the Walmart parking lot about keeping them tidy.
No recorded votes were taken; the next meeting was set for Tuesday May 18th on Zoom, then June 1st.

why_it_matters: The trash contract change is expected to raise the price of trash bags, which residents pay directly, and the electricity aggregation rebid sets the supply rate many households will pay after November.
watch_next: Tuesday May 18th on Zoom, then June 1st, are the next Select Board meetings.
The electricity aggregation contract expires in November; the consultant's RFP results will set the next rate.
